subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A phone update showed users how many hours they spent on each app.”?
options: The city had simply covered them.
In fact, he simply could not see well.
It simply gave others a way to notice them.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「The city had simply covered them.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「In fact, he simply could not see well.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「It simply gave others a way to notice them.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「It simply showed him himself.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
